description:
This is an edited transcript of a talk I gave at EAG NYC 2026.

I'm Jeff Kaufman, and I lead SecureBio Detection.

There's a lot of interest right now in new projects to reduce catastrophic risk, and I thought it would be interesting to look at how the project of SecureBio Detection grew from a concept to a running system.

I should warn you up front, I am a very narrative-driven person, and so a lot of this will feel a bit neat, as if stages inexorably flowed together. But the real world is messy and contingent, with key decisions downstream from mistakes, personality conflicts, and luck. There are generalizable insights here, however, and I'm going to see what I can share.

I joined the project early on, but wasn't there for the beginning: I can't speak to quite the whole journ
title: Transcript: Building an Early Warning System for Pandemics
